title: Brief Mindfulness Intervention for Pain Before an In-clinic Orthopedic Procedure
official: Brief (i.e., <10 Minute) Behavioral Intervention for Pain
summary: This project is a single-site, randomized controlled trial designed to investigate the impact of a 7-minute mindfulness intervention on pain among patients undergoing kyphoplasty or radiofrequency ablation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Undergoing Kyphoplasty or Radiofrequency Ablation at Tallahassee Orthopedic Center
* Fluency with English
* Being 18 and above

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to consent because of physical or mental incapacity.
